an9.37:1.1: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando kosambiyaṃ viharati ghositārāme.
an9.37:1.2: tatra kho āyasmā ānando bhikkhū āmantesi
an9.37:1.4: āvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato ānandassa paccassosuṃ.
an9.37:2.2: yāvañcidaṃ tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena okāsādhigamo anubuddho sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya
an9.37:2.3: tadeva nāma cakkhuṃ bhavissati te rūpā tañcāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedissati
an9.37:2.4: tadeva nāma sotaṃ bhavissati te saddā tañcāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedissati
an9.37:2.5: tadeva nāma ghānaṃ bhavissati te gandhā tañcāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedissati
an9.37:2.6: sā ca nāma jivhā bhavissati te rasā tañcāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedissati
an9.37:2.7: so ca nāma kāyo bhavissati te phoṭṭhabbā tañcāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedissatīti.
an9.37:3.1: evaṃ vutte āyasmā udāyi āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca
an9.37:3.2: saññī meva nu kho āvuso ānanda tadāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedeti udāhu asaññīti.
an9.37:3.3: saññī meva kho āvuso tadāyatanaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti no asaññīti.
an9.37:4.2: idhāvuso bhikkhu sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅgamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāsoti ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.37:4.3: evaṃsaññīpi kho āvuso tadāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedeti
an9.37:5.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu sabbaso ākāsānañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇanti viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.37:5.2: evaṃsaññīpi kho āvuso tadāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedeti
an9.37:6.1: puna caparaṃ āvuso bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇañcāyatanaṃ samatikkamma natthi kiñcīti ākiñcaññāyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati
an9.37:6.2: evaṃsaññīpi kho āvuso tadāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedeti.
an9.37:7.1: ekamidāhaṃ āvuso samayaṃ sākete viharāmi añjanavane migadāye
an9.37:7.2: athakho āvuso jaṭilabhāgikā bhikkhunī yenāhaṃ tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā maṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ aṭṭhāsi ekamantaṃ ṭhitā kho āvuso jaṭilabhāgikā bhikkhunī maṃ etadavoca
an9.37:7.3: yāyaṃ bhante ānanda samādhi na cābhinato na cāpanato na sasaṅkhāraniggayhavāritavato
an9.37:7.4: vimuttattā ṭhito ṭhitattā santusito santusitattā no paritassati
an9.37:7.5: ayaṃ bhante ānanda samādhi kiṃphalo vutto bhagavatāti
an9.37:8.1: evaṃ vutte tāhaṃ āvuso jaṭilabhāgikaṃ bhikkhuniṃ etadavocaṃ
an9.37:8.2: yāyaṃ bhagini samādhi na cābhinato na cāpanato na sasaṅkhāraniggayhavāritavato
an9.37:8.3: vimuttattā ṭhito ṭhitattā santusito santusitattā no paritassati
an9.37:8.4: ayaṃ bhagini samādhi añño phalo vutto bhagavatāti
an9.37:8.5: evaṃsaññīpi kho āvuso tadāyatanaṃ no paṭisaṃvedetīti. 38
